coverage.headline: Only 1 of the 2 MCP servers on this machine runs through Sievant; the other bypasses every control below.
coverage.policy: The server wrapped by sievant wrap runs under sievant proxy's defaults (credentials in arguments blocked, secrets redacted, prompt injection scored; no path or URL allowlists); sievant wrap --all --policy <file> applies a profile written by sievant init.

architecture.deployment: Gateway: agents connect to Sievant over Streamable HTTP
architecture.identity: API keys: 2 keys for 2 agents, stored as SHA-256 digests

connectors.name: crm
connectors.tools: 2 listed tools, each pinned by SHA-256

connectors.name: docs
connectors.tools: every tool the server offers, not pinned

stages: Policy: is this agent allowed this tool, prompt or resource, with these arguments
Input checks: credentials and personal data in the arguments
Forward to the MCP server (SSRF guard, response size cap)
Output checks: redaction, prompt-injection scoring, row and byte budgets

controls.name: Enforcement mode (enforce or observe)

controls.detail: API keys: 2 keys for 2 agents, stored as SHA-256 digests. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: MCP client servers routed through Sievant
controls.detail: 1 of 2 MCP servers in the client configurations run through Sievant.

controls.name: Deny-by-default policies for tools, prompts and resources, per agent
controls.detail: 2 policies; ops-bot may call every tool (allow: "*"). Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Schema validation and argument constraints (min, max, in, matches, path_under, url_hosts)
controls.detail: 1 argument constraint, on top of input-schema validation. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Path and URL argument rules for every tool
controls.detail: Path arguments must be under 1 listed root; the other rule is not configured. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Credentials and personal data in tool arguments blocked or redacted
controls.detail: Credentials in arguments: block; personal data in arguments: redact. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Credentials and personal data redacted from tool results
controls.detail: Results are redacted before the agent sees them: email, credit_card, us_ssn, jwt, aws_access_key, pem_private_key, password. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Prompt-injection detection on arguments and results (flag, annotate, block)
controls.detail: Arguments and results are scored; suspect results are annotated for the model and recorded, not blocked. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Tool definitions read once, pinned, and pinned on first use
controls.detail: 1 of 2 MCP connectors pin their tools. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Upstream resources and prompts not served unchecked
controls.detail: Upstream resources and prompts are withheld unless a connector serves them, and served ones pass the output checks. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Rate limits per agent and per tool
controls.detail: Rate limits: 5 calls a second per agent by default (bursts of 10). Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Row, byte and response-memory budgets
controls.detail: Results are capped at 65536 bytes and 1000 rows; row and byte budgets limit what an agent reads over time. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: SSRF guard on outbound connectors
controls.detail: 1 network connector; private addresses are refused. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

controls.name: Client configuration audit (sievant scan)
controls.detail: 1 client configuration file scanned; findings: 1 medium, 1 info (sievant scan lists them).

controls.name: Audit trail of every call and security event
controls.detail: Every call and security event is recorded in the local audit store, kept 30 days; inputs are sanitized and keyed with an HMAC, so a record can be matched to its input without storing it. Applies to the 1 of 2 MCP servers on this machine that run through Sievant.

gaps.title: 1 MCP server bypasses Sievant on this machine
gaps.detail: These client servers talk to their agent directly, with no policy, redaction or audit: search (claude-desktop).
gaps.fix: sievant wrap --all routes them through Sievant (sievant unwrap restores the files).

gaps.title: 1 medium finding in client configurations
gaps.detail: sievant scan found issues such as unpinned server versions in the MCP client configurations.
gaps.fix: Run sievant scan and apply each finding's fix.

gaps.title: MCP tool definitions are not pinned
gaps.detail: Connector docs serves tools whose descriptions and schemas are not pinned, so a server could change what the model reads without review.
gaps.fix: Turn on pinning.first_use (pack description-pinning), or list each tool with its sha256 (sievant proxy --list-tools prints them).

gaps.title: An agent may call every tool
gaps.detail: The policy of ops-bot allows "*": a steered agent can reach every tool, including ones it never needs.
gaps.fix: Replace the wildcard with the tools the agent uses: sievant policy suggest --since 30d drafts that list from the audit trail.

gaps.title: The audit trail covers part of the period
gaps.detail: The oldest record in the period is from 2026-10-10; the period starts 2026-09-19.
gaps.fix: Keep records for at least the reporting period (audit.local.retention), or report on a shorter --period.
